title: Operator cockpit: scaling presets, throughput insights, and change-rewind
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Ship an 'Operator Cockpit' within Console that centralizes fleet scaling presets, live throughput and cost forecasts, and a changelog UI that supports time-travel/rewind to safely revert fleet policies. This feature is targeted at Dedicated customers and platform teams who need predictable throughput guarantees with clear auditability and fast rollback when scaling regressions or incidents occur.
acceptance_criteria: A single Console page (Operator Cockpit) shows scaling presets for a fleet with create/edit/delete flows and RBAC restrictions
Live throughput dashboard: p95 latency, tokens/s, active GPUs, and projected capacity under current presets for the next 60 minutes
Cost forecast widget that estimates per-hour and per-100k-token cost based on active batching & quantization profiles
Changelog timeline that records operator actions, policy rollouts, and autoscaler decisions with ability to 'rewind' to any previous preset state
Rewind operation performs a dry-run simulation and exposes conflicts, then optionally applies the selected historic preset with a canary option
Audit log exports (CSV/JSON) for compliance and SSO/SCIM identity mapping tied to each change
E2E tests for UI flows, guardrail enforcement, and telemetry events sent to observability backends
Documentation and runbook linked from the UI explaining rollback semantics and customer-impact signals
comments: 2025-02-11 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting with Eng and Design. Key constraint: change history must be immutable for compliance. We agreed on two-step rewind (dry-run + apply).

2025-02-17 - Marco Ruiz: Design critique: added cost-forecast microcopy and suggested putting canary options next to environment target selector. Action: Designer to provide new mockups by 2025-02-21.

2025-02-22 - Priya Menon (Eng): Tech design review — proposed implementation: store presets as versioned blobs in central config store; autoscaler will emit decision events for timeline. Raised concern about migration of existing presets; created ENG-92012 for migration plan.
2025-02-25 - Marco Ruiz: UX update — mock v2 uploaded to Figma (link below). PM asked for keyboard shortcuts for quick-revert for SREs. Added to scope as low-priority.

2025-03-01 - Security review (Samir Khan): Confirmed RBAC mapping and audit export format acceptable. Flag: irreversible delete needs a soft-delete retention of 30 days. Marked security_review_required=true.

2025-03-03 - Marco Ruiz: Engineering spike completed. Performance note: computing live projections adds ~120ms to API endpoint if we include all fleet nodes; propose pre-aggregating telemetry to reduce cost. ENG-93440 created to implement aggregation layer.
